step.label: Initiate customer campaign provisioning
step.description: Set up customer accounts and campaign parameters to begin the product launch initiative across target markets.
step.useCase: Sales teams activate new customer relationships for the upcoming product release campaign.

step.label: Qualify materials and vendors
step.description: Assess material specifications and vendor capabilities to ensure supply chain readiness for production transition.
step.useCase: Procurement confirms that all materials and vendors meet quality standards before manufacturing begins.

step.label: Analyze product cost and complexity
step.description: Evaluate cost drivers and technical complexity of product items to optimize manufacturing and logistics strategy.
step.useCase: Finance and product teams understand cost implications and design complexity to inform pricing and production planning.

step.label: Retrieve engineering change specifications
step.description: Obtain detailed engineering change orders and product item data to ensure manufacturing teams have current specifications.
step.useCase: Manufacturing obtains the latest engineering changes needed to update production processes and equipment configurations.

step.label: Assess material change readiness and workforce impact
step.description: Evaluate how material changes affect production workflows and identify workforce training and redeployment needs.
step.useCase: Human Resources determines which employees require training and when skill gaps must be addressed before production ramp-up.

step.label: Evaluate production transition capability and skill requirements
step.description: Analyze production capacity, skill gaps, and workforce readiness against engineering changes to validate launch feasibility.
step.useCase: Operations leadership confirms that the workforce has required skills and capacity to execute the manufacturing transition successfully.

step.label: Monitor employee performance against manufacturing standards
step.description: Track production quality metrics and employee performance to ensure manufacturing execution meets launch targets.
step.useCase: Quality and HR teams verify that employees are performing at required standards during production ramp-up.

step.label: Orchestrate sales compensation adjustments
step.description: Calculate and apply compensation adjustments based on successful product launch performance and sales achievements.
step.useCase: Sales leadership aligns employee compensation with successful product launch metrics and revenue targets.
